d: Hall of audience with throne on one side, greats of the kingdom, Guards, Polibius and Siveno at his feet.
At the sound of warlike march, Eumene advances with gifts and Follow; Polibio climbs on the throne surrounded by his; a Parto places the seat for the Ambassador.
Magnificent temple with plow, and throne on one side. Siveno, Priests and People; then Polybius followed by Greats of the kingdom, in the end Lisinga.
Great square with view of the royal palace. Eumene with Séguito.
Royal cabinet with alcove and sofa. Night. Lising in the act of rest, then Eumenes by a side door followed by 'his, all armed and with fiery faces.
Royal Cabinet... great of the kingdom, then Polibio, then Siveno.
Remote places not far from the city. Eumenes, which leads Lisinga escorted by 'his, Siveno and Polibio with their follow.
Audience room with coffee table and chairs. Grandi del regno, indi Lisinga who sits in pain, then Polibio.
Camping sight of the city. Encamped guards, Eumenes from his tent, in Siveno and Lisinga followed by his own.
Everyone puts themselves in order to march by singing the choir, after which Eumene, Lisinga and Siveno with them walk towards the city. They all remain suspended meeting with Polibio and him Follow.
